app_info.subtitle: Multi-Service Action Platform
app_info.description: Natural marketplace assistant enabling customers to discover services, calculate verified quotes, order coffee and food, and track orders with explicit confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves the conversational welcome greeting and active marketplace capability metrics for customers.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is strictly an internal lookup on active platform offering counts.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only searches and filters registered capability providers by category, capability flags, geography, or keyword queries without altering state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is an internal query against platform registry metadata and does not interact with open external networks.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero state mutations.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only queries and lists registered active capability providers from the platform database without altering state or creating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is an internal lookup against platform registry metadata and does not interact with open external networks.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive changes or state mutations.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves metadata and supported capabilities for a specific provider without changing state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool reads registry metadata and makes no external state mutations.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves capability flags for a specific provider without changing state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool reads registry capability metadata.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves physical branch locations, addresses, and operating hours without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is a read query against provider location endpoints.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves categories, offerings, base prices, and option groups without mutating provider data.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool queries provider catalog endpoints in read-only mode.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool searches offerings matching keywords or filter criteria without modifying state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool queries provider search endpoints in read-only mode.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool fetches details, variants, option groups, and prices for a single offering without state mutation.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool queries provider offering endpoints in read-only mode.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool verifies real-time stock or availability without creating reservations, holds, or state changes.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool queries provider live inventory availability in read-only mode.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool persists a temporary Quote calculation record with TTL in the database for subsequent verified confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool queries provider pricing engines without committing orders to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool calculates pricing and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool creates orders/actions with provider systems, persisting transactional records and generating payment handoff links.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool commits confirmed actions to external provider systems across the network.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool creates new operational actions and is not destructive.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool queries current status, tracking events, and fulfillment updates for an existing action without changing its state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool performs status lookup against provider status endpoints.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool permanently cancels an eligible active action before fulfillment lock or completion.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool communicates with external provider systems to release reservations and cancel ongoing processing.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool permanently cancels the action on the external provider and initiates settlement adjustments.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves provider-supplied HTTPS checkout URLs and payment method instructions without handling sensitive payment data or mutating balances.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool queries external provider checkout endpoint metadata.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive effects.

test_cases.description: Multi-Criteria Service and Coffee Time Provider Discovery
test_cases.user_prompt: Toshkentda qanday qahvaxona va yetkazib berish xizmatlari bor?
test_cases.expected_output: "Coffee Time Sandbox Demo" xizmati topildi. Menyu yoki takliflarni ko‘rishni xohlaysizmi?

test_cases.description: Coffee Time Branch Locations and Menu Catalog Inspection
test_cases.user_prompt: Coffee Time filiallari qayerda joylashgan va menyusida nimalar bor?
test_cases.expected_output:
Mavjud filiallar: Coffee Time — Chilonzor Test Branch, Coffee Time — Yunusobod Test Branch.

Menyu takliflari:
• Cappuccino — 18 000 so‘m
• Americano — 15 000 so‘m
• Iced Latte — 24 000 so‘m
• Cheesecake — 28 000 so‘m

test_cases.description: Verified Quotation and Real-time Pricing Calculation
test_cases.user_prompt: Coffee Time dan 1 ta Cappuccino Toshkent, Chilonzorga yetkazib berish bilan qancha bo'ladi?
test_cases.expected_output:
Buyurtma hisob-kitobi:

• Cappuccino × 1 — 18 000 so‘m
Yetkazib berish / xizmat haqi: 10 000 so‘m
Jami: 28 000 so‘m

Buyurtmani tasdiqlaysizmi?

test_cases.description: Explicit User-Confirmed Action Execution & Sandbox Checkout Handoff
test_cases.user_prompt: Ha, narx ma'qul, buyurtmani tasdiqlayman. Ismim Alisher, telefonim +998901234567.
test_cases.expected_output:
Buyurtmangiz yaratildi. To‘lov kutilmoqda.

Bu Coffee Time sandbox demo xizmati. Haqiqiy buyurtma yoki to‘lov amalga oshirilmaydi.

[To‘lov sahifasini ochish](https://coffee-time-sandbox.shopla.uz/pay/...)

test_cases.description: Live Action Status and Order Tracking
test_cases.user_prompt: Mening Coffee Time buyurtmam holati qanday?
test_cases.expected_output:
Buyurtmangiz qabul qilingan, lekin to‘lov hali qilinmagan.
